summary:
Pixelated Farming is an intelligent agricultural decision-support platform that uses NASA Earth observation data to help farmers make informed and sustainable crop rotation decisions. By integrating satellite observations, historical climate records, precipitation patterns, temperature trends, and soil moisture information, the platform analyses environmental conditions affecting farmland.

It provides interactive farm mapping, environmental monitoring, vegetation analysis, and an intelligent crop recommendation engine. By evaluating growing conditions, water requirements, seasonal suitability, and previous crop history, Pixelated Farming suggests suitable crops and effective rotation strategies. Each recommendation includes clear explanations, helping farmers understand the environmental factors influencing their decisions.

Through interactive visualisations and an AI-powered agricultural assistant, users can explore historical trends, identify potential environmental risks, and plan for changing agricultural conditions.

Pixelated Farming transforms complex satellite data into practical agricultural insights, helping farmers adapt to environmental changes, improve crop planning, and support more sustainable farming practices.
